description.value: You can write computer programs. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Earn Income] using Computers, spending your time programming apps for clients. You can also Craft items with the virtual trait. You can use Programmer to Craft tech items that don't have the virtual trait, but you can only cover up to a quarter of the item's cost in raw materials; the remaining Crafting has to be completed by someone using the Crafting skill.
